about: Every program system and every hook into a game's files. One row = one C# class.

rows.does: Parse --deadlock <path> (from Melty's {game}) and --onlyup <path> overrides; env ONLYBEBOP_DEADLOCK as fallback.
Find Steam root (registry HKCU\Software\Valve\Steam SteamPath, default paths), parse libraryfolders.vdf and appmanifest_<appid>.acf to find each game's folder.
rows.test: unit: headless --selftest with a fake Steam tree

rows.does: tools/deadlock-extract.exe: open pak01_dir.vpk, read heroes.vdata + abilities.vdata, export Bebop model+anims to glb, roster cards to png, listed sound events to wav, write cache manifest.
tools/onlyup-extract.exe: mount paks, pick the world map, export unique static meshes to glb + instance list json, music to wav/ogg, write cache manifest.
%LOCALAPPDATA%/OnlyBebop/cache/<game>/manifest.json keyed by source archive sizes+mtimes; re-runs an extractor when its game updates. Never leaves the player's PC.
First scene: locate both games, show missing-game screen or run extractors with a progress bar, then hero select.
rows.test: headless run with no games -> missing screen

rows.does: Grid of roster cards from cache; Bebop playable, others 'Coming soon'; pick plays Bebop's pick VO.
Load mesh glbs once, place instances (cm->m, UE left-handed Z-up -> Godot Y-up), add trimesh StaticBody3D colliders, find spawn.
CharacterBody3D with movement sheet rows: run, sprint, jump, air jump, dashes, stamina, mantle, gravity. Bebop glb as visual with idle/run/jump anims when present.
rows.test: headless physics bench on a test tower (--selftest)

rows.does: Deadlock-style over-the-shoulder third-person camera with collision.
Stamina pips, ability icons with cooldowns, height above spawn, first-seconds prompts from inputs sheet.
Loop Only Up! music from cache.
